question: What does one carrier, two faces and three relations converge toward when no literal fixed point is expected?
compressedAnswer: The terminal is not a final state. It is a stable, provenance-bearing, detector-complete return class: the carrier returns equivalent under the declared quotient, while a measurable path residue and complete resource ledger survive.

recurringGrammar.one: one typed carrier persists strongly enough to be followed through change
recurringGrammar.two: two faces, sectors, polarizations or alternatives create comparison without becoming two unrelated carriers
recurringGrammar.three: three composable relations, or a relation plus an independent detector intervention, form the smallest loop that can expose a return defect
recurringGrammar.return: the fourth move is not another object; it is return to the carrier as C-prime, equivalent to C only under a declared quotient
recurringGrammar.recursion: repeating the return produces a helix or nested coarse-graining: the grammar can stabilize even when the microscopic state never does

terminalObject.name: stable reconstructible return class

components.R: typed relational composition including the minimal consistency loop
components.D: detector map and its equivalence classes
components.Omega: observable holonomy, phase, orientation, memory or other return residue
components.Lambda: source, energetic, entropy, calibration and uncertainty ledger
components.approximately: gauge, basis, label and detector quotient declared in advance

terminalObject.returnCondition: Phi^m(C) approximately C for some declared return depth m
terminalObject.stabilityCondition: transverse perturbations contract or remain within a certified invariant set
terminalObject.reconstructionCondition: a preregistered decoder recovers the same return class and predicts held-out records
terminalObject.nontrivialityCondition: Omega or a held-out relational record distinguishes the mechanism from counterfeits
terminalObject.provenanceCondition: the split, relations, detector and orientation come from one carrier/action or independently calibrated controls
terminalObject.ledgerCondition: mechanisms with the same state-level return remain distinct when their thermodynamic or informational costs differ

fixedPointRelation.fixedPoint: m=1 and Omega=0 is a special degenerate terminal
fixedPointRelation.limitCycle: m>1 with a stable periodic return
fixedPointRelation.holonomy: the base carrier returns while its transported fiber acquires Omega
fixedPointRelation.metastableAttractor: return is statistical or long-lived rather than exact
fixedPointRelation.renormalization: microscopic carriers change while an effective type shape and prediction law stabilize
fixedPointRelation.conclusion: the corpus supports terminality in quotient/process space, not necessarily a fixed microscopic state

finiteToy.state: (stage,r) with stage in Z3 and transverse coordinate r
finiteToy.coarseDetector: r alone collapses the three stages

corpusConvergences.contribution: repeated elimination preserves a positive relational response shape through a ternary update
the same 1 plus A2 plane, metric and orientation grammar recurs across independent constructions, while labels and physical provenance remain open
Sp(4,R)=Spin_0(2,3) is the continuous response envelope generated after independent anisotropies are supplied; it is a closure algebra, not the final selected state
forward endpoint, reverse tomography and singular values are jointly required to separate geometric, static and dissipative mechanisms
the same fixed population, contraction and duration can hide equilibrium, driven and monitored implementations with different entropy or reset costs
curvature reconstructs only a quotient; Wilson periods and helicity carry return information erased by local fields
scalar traces reconstruct the unoriented 23AB quotient but not 23A versus 23B; defect, sewing or OPE records must enlarge the detector
the scientific terminal is an evolving typed boundary with explicit gates and falsifiers, not an assertion that inquiry has ended

strongestCurrentVerdict: The corpus is converging toward a self-consistent law of admissible transport: one carrier differentiates into two faces, three relations close the first diagnostic loop, and repeated traversal approaches a stable reconstructible return class with an irreducible residue. The invariant is the return grammar and its prediction law, not necessarily the state.
